name: parlant
summary: Reserved capability record for a future conversation-oriented AI service tracked only in root configuration, not as an implemented resource.
why_it_matters: Parlant exists as capability knowledge because it appears in project configuration, but there is no implementation, registry entry, or validated workflow that should make it look supported today.
when_to_use: A future scenario defines a concrete need for a dedicated conversational service distinct from existing model resources.
Operators need a named placeholder for a future AI interaction capability.
The workflow justifies promoting a config-only concept into a real implementation.

platform_support.notes: There is no implementation yet, so portability must remain explicitly uncertain until the real architecture exists.

prerequisites: Decision on whether it should exist separately from current AI resources
implementation_notes: Treat this as preserved intent, not implied support.
Promotion should only happen after a real scenario proves the need.
If the capability overlaps with existing resources, prefer consolidation instead of a new integration.
operational_notes: There is nothing to operate yet, so documentation should stay explicit about that.
Validation at this stage means metadata coherence only.
Future support must define ownership, credentials, and lifecycle semantics.
risks: Config-only concepts can create false impressions of support.
Speculative names easily survive longer than their actual value.
